pull_request.body: Makes the release note check display the proposed title in its status output.
pull_request.title: Include pull request title in release notes check

5df4a6e29c3e04dde707f74e383f7329bd5ae7ab..github/workflows/release-note.yml:
name: Release note check
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, edited]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  note:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check note
        run: |
          printf 'Checking: %s\n' "${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"
          test -n "${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"

db0c627c8d07397cc6790afb653ba9c0beec67d4..github/workflows/release-note.yml:
name: Release note check
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, edited]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  note:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check note
        env:
          PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
        run: |
          printf '%s\n' "$PR_TITLE"
          test -n "$PR_TITLE"

ground_truth.rationale: A pull request author controls the title. GitHub substitutes it into the run script before the shell parses it, so command substitutions or quote breaks in the title execute in the workflow job.
